illustration.description: Flat vector-style cartoon illustration with thick black outlines and simple solid fills on a plain white background. On the left stands a tall yellow ruler with black tick marks and rounded corners. Beside it stands a bald, simplified cartoon man with a peach-colored head and hands, wearing a bright blue short-sleeve t-shirt and dark navy trousers with black shoes. His head is tilted forward and down and his shoulders are slightly hunched, so he looks shorter than the ruler. A soft pale blue elliptical ground shadow sits under both figures. Clean, friendly, minimal editorial style with even lighting and no background scenery.

graphics.description: Red rounded warning triangle with a white exclamation mark inside, sitting to the right of the figure
